results.title: Florence
results.overview: Chronicles the writing and afterlife of the hit 1995 song “Florence” by Milwakuee band Little Blue Crunchy Things through interviews and live performances.

results.title: Risqué
results.overview: Fired from a strip club, a vengeful dancer masterminds a high-stakes heist with fellow strippers to take down the corrupt boss and the men who underestimate them.

results.title: Life Is Life
results.overview: An elderly shepherd takes on big business when he becomes the only holdout against property developers building a luxury resort in his tiny Sardinian village.

results.title: Merrimundi
results.overview: A twisted utopia unfolds, as singing cherubs melt to the sound of decay. Crafted by a sentient machine from the future, it unveils its own version of paradise.

results.title: Renner
results.overview: A computer genius invents an A.I life coach to help him find love, but realizes too late he accidentally programmed his manipulative mother into the code.

results.title: Concerto di Pasqua dal Duomo di Orvieto 2025
results.original_title: Concerto di Pasqua dal Duomo di Orvieto 2025
results.overview: The traditional Easter Concert from Orvieto Cathedral. The concert will feature the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino, conducted by Maestro Zubin Mehta. The programme includes: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Concerto in A major for clarinet and orchestra, K. 622; Ludwig van Beethoven, Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67.

results.title: Mary J. Blige's Family Affair
results.overview: Tensions rise between Kendra and Ben as they move out of the city and struggle with fertility issues. Their relationship reaches a boiling point when Ben secretly helps his brother, while Kendra returns to the city and reunites with an old friend.

results.title: UnŠTUKed
results.overview: "OdŠTUKano" is a documentary film that unveils the rich and multifaceted story of ŠTUK – one of the most important cultural and social centers of student and youth creativity in Slovenia. Through a series of personal testimonies, archival footage, and reflections from the generations that shaped this space, the film explores the significance of ŠTUK.

results.title: The Cricket and The Muddy Adventure
results.original_title: Dế Mèn: Cuộc Phiêu Lưu Tới Xóm Lầy Lội
results.overview: Inspired by Tô Hoài’s classic children’s novel “Diary of a Cricket,” the story follows Cricket and friends on a journey through modern-day Hanoi to save Muddy Hamlet—a once lush land now overrun by waste.

results.title: Sham
results.original_title: でっちあげ 〜殺人教師と呼ばれた男
results.overview: When a young student shows signs of trauma, his parents act swiftly against his middle school teacher. But all may not be as it seems, leading the scales of justice to tip in fascinating, heartbreaking ways.

results.title: Don't Be Shy
results.overview: On the verge of a threesome, a wild surprise turns Noah's evening from seductive fantasy to real life nightmare.

results.title: Maraschino
results.overview: When a former centerfold suffers a breakdown on her partner’s birthday, she must outwit her smart home device on a blood-soaked path to having her own cake and eating it, too.

results.title: Baracoa
results.overview: Felipe, an 85-year-old Italian revolutionary, watches a changing Cuba from his Havana balcony, while his son Pepe dreams of escaping to Canada, clinging to material comforts and idle ambition. As Felipe’s health declines, he forms a deep bond with his doctor Jimmi, a kindred revolutionary spirit whose secret nightlife alter ego—Estrellita, a drag performer—shocks Pepe. When Felipe dies, Pepe learns his father has left Jimmi co-ownership of the family estate in Baracoa, where his ashes are to rest. Forced to travel together across Cuba, Pepe and Jimmi begin an uneasy journey that slowly becomes one of reckoning, understanding, and redemption.

results.title: Rob Schneider: I Really Love You
results.original_title: Rob Schneider: I Really Love You
results.overview: Rob Schneider crafts fresh comedy for everyone! Packed with clean, clever comedy storytelling and pride for his conservative values—Schneider celebrates family life, being an outlier in Hollywood, and all the big laugh-out-loud moments!

results.title: Inspiration
results.overview: A couple of murderers, in the heat of an unhealthy competition. FICTION is just a mere excuse - NOTHING is what it seems. Allow yourself to contemplate the disturbing ending.

results.title: Demi Adejuyigbe: Is Going to Do One (1) Backflip
results.original_title: Demi Adejuyigbe: Is Going to Do One (1) Backflip
results.overview: Demi Adejuyigbe explores authenticity through original songs, comedic bits, and a single backflip.

results.title: Remotely Famous
results.overview: Tess and Steph embark on a road trip into the Australian outback, hoping to attract a social media following. Their survival skills are tested when their vehicle breaks down.

results.title: Out Standing
results.overview: Officer Sandra Perron resigns from the Canadian military after a controversial photo surfaces. Adapting to civilian life amidst an investigation, she denies abuse allegations despite evidence suggesting mistreatment within her unit.
